scope: Interior same-time research moment-prior construction on a copied 2026-08-16 13:00 UTC native WRF input. Not a complete native process admission or boundary/donor initialization.

prior.center_policy: For each positive-mass cell with an exactly zero moment, use the geometric midpoint of the source-supported lambda interval after intersecting its upper endpoint with the per-cell source internal-number cap. QIB uses QGRAUP divided by the explicitly declared 400 kg m-3 bulk-density center.
prior.fill_policy: Fill every exact positive mass, including values below native process cutoffs; preserve exact zero mass as zero moment; never floor/delete mass. Preserve an existing nonzero moment only when it passes the source PSD/density validator and native cap.
prior.uncertainty: Declared source-admissibility envelope and deterministic prior center, not a statistical uncertainty or recovered observation. Mean particle mass bounds apply to the gamma PSD mean, not each particle.
prior.active_domain: All 39 mass levels and native interior horizontal cells (array indices [:,1:-1,1:-1]); outer input ring is preserved byte-for-byte. Boundary/donor-period forcing and outer-ring moments are not constructed by this prior.
prior.source_cap_failure: If any positive mass has no number satisfying both its source lambda interval and internal-number cap, reject the complete initialization before writing an output input. Do not relax source bounds, alter Q, or floor moments.
prior.native_process_scope: Positive-mass moment construction uses exact Q>0, while native KDM6 process predicates impose additional species cutoffs. This prior does not claim every initialized cell is process-active or that all native physical admission constraints are met.

source.model: Source-equation reference for KDM6 PSD bounds; actual retained same13 consumer is separately bound below.
source.formula_comparison: Source equations and constants are bound to the selected KDM6 source, upstream formula comparison, WRF model constants, and driver. No 12 UTC first-call density trace is used.
source.kdm6_source_ranges: private wrapper lines 320-327; parameters lines 57-100 and 131-135; PSD inversions lines 1372-1408; pidn formulas lines 3105-3163; graupel density range lines 3283-3310
source.driver_density_binding: module_microphysics_driver.F:2552 passes QMIN=epsilon and DENR=rhowater to KDM6; module_model_constants.F:10 defines epsilon=1e-15
source.runtime_consumer_scope: Retained PR81 nine-object WRF v4.8 component observed in PR82 same13 handoff; bind actual KDM6 source, archive, member, executable and readback receipt. Compiler/link closure and operational equivalence are not established.
source.runtime_consumer_parameter_locations: lambda values lines 93-99; nrmax/ncmax lines 116-117; QNICE clamp line 1564; pidn formulas lines 4253, 4283, 4311; graupel density support lines 4433-4435.

runtime_native_branch_thresholds.threshold_role: Native process branch predicates differ from research fill cutoff (exact Q > 0); all exact positive mass is proposed for initialization.

density_source.formula: alt = real32(AL + ALB) in source operation order; rho_dry = real32(1.0) / alt
density_source.kdm6_density_bridge: KDM6 source forms moist density from 1/alt*(1+QV), then the dry-carrier relation divides by (1+QV); AL+ALB is the source inverse dry-density quantity used for the same-time prior/cap.
density_source.thermodynamic_crosscheck: WRF p_phy=p+pb; pi_phy=(p/p1000mb)**(r_d/cp); t_phy=(T+300)*pi_phy. Pinned constants are r_d=287, cp=7*r_d/2=1004.5, r_v=461.6, p0=p1000mb=100000 Pa. This is a consistency cross-check only; source AL+ALB is authoritative for the native cap.

QGRAUP.source_lines: ProgB_param defines rho_mid=400 kg m-3 as default density and rho_min/rho_max=[100,900] kg m-3. The separate zero-BG fallback sets rhox=rho_max=900 and is not this prior.

QSNOW.treatment: Preserved mass-only field; selected MP37 interface has no corresponding prognostic native snow number or bulk-volume input moment.

preflight.incomplete_scope: This constructor only proposes interior moment priors; it does not build boundary/donor-period moment forcing, alter the outer ring, or guarantee complete native physical admission.
